info.title: Saka control API
info.description: Local control API of a Saka server.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Start after this `seq` (`Last-Event-ID` wins when both are given).

200.description: One `data` per event, `id` = seq. `runtime.session.activity.v1` messages carry an ActivityNotice and no `id`.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: One or more of `pending, allowed, denied, expired`, comma-separated.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path of the file relative to the workspace repo root, inside the project folder.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path of the file relative to the workspace repo root, inside the project folder.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: "<blob>" of the file being replaced, or * for any existing file

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: * to create a file that must not exist yet

200.description: An existing file, changed or already equal

204.description: The secret is gone, or never existed

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: One or more of `draft, ready, approved, shipped, withdrawn`, comma-separated.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Only the spec registered at exactly this path (at most 1024 bytes).

parameters.name: work_item_id
parameters.description: Exactly one of `work_item_id` and `spec_draft_id` is required.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return the activities right after this offset. At most one of `after`, `before`, and `tail`.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Return the activities right before this offset, still in ascending order.

parameters.name: tail
parameters.description: `true` returns the last `limit` activities, in ascending order.

parameters.name: work_item_id
parameters.description: One of `work_item_id`, `spec_draft_id`, and `session_id` is required; `work_item_id` and `spec_draft_id` are exclusive.

ActivityNotice.description: The `data` of a `runtime.session.activity.v1` SSE message: a new timeline row to read with the timeline cursor.

paused.description: A window is at or above `agent.rate_limit_pause` and has not reset; new tasks wait.

remember.description: With `allow` only: also allow the same tool (and, for Bash, the same whole command) in this project from now on.

line.description: Line of the first link in the spec; `1` for `always`.

origin.description: `link` (linked from the spec) or `always` (marked `context: always` in the project folder).

path.description: Path relative to the workspace repo root.

blob.description: Git blob sha of the file; also the strong `ETag`.

commit.description: Tip of the base branch the file was read at.

content.description: The exact file content (a leading BOM is U+FEFF; line endings are kept as they are).

blob.description: Git blob sha of the file at the tip.

path.description: Path relative to the workspace repo root.

FileTree.description: Markdown files of the project folder at the tip of the base branch.

commit.description: Tip of the base branch the list was read at.

files.description: Regular `.md`/`.markdown` files under the project folder, sorted by path bytes.

truncated.description: More than 5000 files exist; `files` holds the first 5000.

blob.description: Git blob sha of the file; also the strong `ETag`.

commit.description: The new commit, or the tip when the content was already there (`committed: false`).

committed.description: False when the content equals the file at the tip: no commit was made.

oneOf.description: The spec registered from this file in the same request, with its acceptance criteria.
Why the file was not registered as a spec, although it should have been.

required.description: Whether this source decides merge readiness under the repo's `[gate] source`.

oneOf.description: The revision that was approved; null before the first approval.

decisions.description: Decisions in the latest revision, in written order; empty in list items.

depends_on.description: Specs that must ship before this one starts, resolved in the project.

oneOf.description: Null unless the spec is approved and a newer revision is recorded.

cost_usd.description: Decimal string in dollars, or `null` when the CLI did not report it.

oneOf.description: Use and limits of the running stage run; `null` when no stage run with a session runs.
The latest environment of the task; `null` before one was prepared.

gates.description: Latest result per gate source for the current change request head, `scm` first.

state.description: `queued | awaiting_start | admitted | in_stage | blocked | taken_over | done | cancelled | superseded`

waiting_on.description: Steps and specs this task still waits for; empty unless the task is queued.

command.description: The whole Bash command; `null` for other tools.

fields.description: Changed fields in the order `work`, `ac`, `commands`, `after`; only for `changed`.

count.description: Ports the recipe asked for, starting at `start`.

status.description: As the CLI reports it, e.g. `allowed`, `allowed_warning`, `rejected`.

context.description: Context documents pinned with this revision, in work packet order (`link` first, then `always`).

context_hash.description: `sha256:<hex>` over the resolved context references; part of the revision identity.

parser_version.description: Version of the parser that read this revision.

RevisionPlan.description: What approving the latest revision again would do to each step.

ready.description: No conflict, clean lint, and the current parser.

content_hash.description: `sha256:<hex>` over the raw bytes of the spec file.

source_commit.description: Commit of the workspace repo the revision was read at.

oneOf.description: A stage run of a task.
An attempt of a spec draft.

RunOwner.description: The run that owns a session, its permission requests, and its usage records.

SecretList.description: The secrets of a project, ordered by name. At most 200, so there is no paging.

SecretName.description: A project secret, by name only.

name.description: `^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}$`, never a name Saka sets itself.

kind.description: `system | thought | message | action | output | permission | result | steer`

SetSecretBody.description: Body of `PUT /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/secrets/{name}`. The value is write-only: no response, event, or log carries it, and it cannot be read back.

value.description: 8 to 65536 bytes of UTF-8 without NUL. Shorter values are refused (`secret_too_short`) so output redaction always applies.

oneOf.description: The revision that was approved; null before the first approval.

decisions.description: Decisions in the latest revision, in written order; empty in list items.

depends_on.description: Specs that must ship before this one starts, resolved in the project.

oneOf.description: Null unless the spec is approved and a newer revision is recorded.

SpecDecision.description: One question from the spec's `## Decisions` section.

chosen.description: 1-based number of the checked option; null while the decision is open.

text.description: Markdown source after the checkbox, trimmed, at most 500 characters (cut with `…`).

spec_id.description: Null when no spec in the project has this slug.

code.description: Same codes as registering a spec: `spec_slug_conflict`, `validation_failed`, `scm_unavailable`.

content.description: Markdown that parses without issues as `example-spec.md`.

text.description: 1 to 4000 characters, sent to the agent as a user message.

after.description: Step ids this step waits for.

StreamEvent.description: One event of `GET /api/v1/events` (the `data` of an SSE message).

next_after.description: Offset of the last item when newer activities existed at read time; pass as `after`. `null` otherwise.

prev_before.description: Offset of the first item when older activities exist; pass as `before`. `null` otherwise.

cost_usd.description: Decimal string in dollars, or `null` when the CLI did not report it.

oneOf.description: A step of the same spec that is not done yet.
A spec that has not shipped yet.
An agent account window at or above `agent.rate_limit_pause` that has not reset yet.
Every port block in `env.port_range` is held by a live environment.
Use and limits of the running stage run; `null` when no stage run with a session runs.
The latest environment of the task; `null` before one was prepared.

gates.description: Latest result per gate source for the current change request head, `scm` first.

state.description: `queued | awaiting_start | admitted | in_stage | blocked | taken_over | done | cancelled | superseded`

waiting_on.description: Steps and specs this task still waits for; empty unless the task is queued.

oneOf.description: `null` when the recipe asks for no ports or the environment is torn down.

recipe_sha256.description: SHA-256 of `.saka/environment.toml` at the base commit; `null` when the repo has no recipe.

toolchains.description: Toolchains on `PATH`; empty when the repo declares no versions.

environment_id.description: The `ready` environment whose ports, toolchains, and session secret names are in the packet.

revision_id.description: Revision the task is pinned to.

text.description: The first turn exactly as the session receives it, without a CI retry paragraph.

content.description: The exact new file content, at most 1 MiB as UTF-8.
